items.title: Tom Scott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I knew him, I had met him a couple of times, a few times here and there.

ctx.x: Is it true that he wrote [scats]. © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

No, no, no, “Twilight Zone?” No. He did do the underscore for several iconic episodes of “Twilight Zone,” I think the most famous one is “A Stop at Willoughby” where a guy takes a train and he goes back to his hometown and he’s an advertising exec or something and he was very unhappy with his life and he gets back to this town and realizes wait a minute, this is the way it looked when I was a kid. And so on. So yes, my father was a wonderful composer, in fact just a little aside, when he passed, you know in the…
